title: Quantitative Model Adoption Propensity Index & Scout Playbook
creator: Nina Patel
description: Goal: produce a repeatable, quantitative "propensity index" that ranks open and partner models by likelihood of customer adoption for Redwood-hosted and Dedicated deployments, and ship a lightweight scouting playbook that ties index scores to specific provisioning and product actions. Success criteria: 1) index explains >= 60% of historical model adoption variance on pilot dataset; 2) playbook yields clear provisioning trigger rules (3-5) used by PM/Eng for fallbacks and procurement; 3) dashboard surfaced in Console for model-readiness signals.
scope: Includes: signal taxonomy and weights (latency/cost, licensing risk, quantization & kernel maturity, region availability, API compatibility, feature coverage, enterprise procurement signals, NPS/request frequency). Deliverables: scoring notebook, weekly dashboard, playbook doc, initial thresholds for provisioning/commitment. Excludes: full procurement negotiations, legal contract work, or on-prem install automation (handled by Contracts/Private teams).
approach: 1) Assemble signal sources: usage telemetry, customer feature requests, partner availability feeds, model technical profiles (quantization friendliness, memory footprint), third-party latency/cost benchmarks. 2) Build labeled pilot: map 18 months of model onboarding/adoption events to signals. 3) Train simple logistic/gradient-boosted model for interpretability and derive index buckets (High/Medium/Low). 4) Iterate thresholds with SRE/DevRel and validate with two enterprise customers. 5) Publish playbook with route actions and monitoring alerts.
data_sources: usage_events (Console), customer-requests CSV (CS ops), partner-supply API, kernel-compatibility matrix (Runtime team), latency-cost bench dataset (Bench/db), procurement lead logs (Sales), legal license flags (Security).
success_metrics: explainability_pct >= 60; precision@top10 >= 0.7 for pilot accounts; number_of_auto_triggers >= 3 implemented in canary routing; decision_time_reduced_by >= 30% for model onboarding cases.
deliverables: 1) Propensity index notebook + exportable CSV; 2) Model-Readiness dashboard tile in Console (signal breakdown per model); 3) Scout playbook doc (PDF + Confluence); 4) Decision triggers YAML for routing/orchestration; 5) Post-mortem and next-steps plan.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: signal sparsity for new models -> Mitigation: use proxy features and prior distribution + conservative thresholds. Risk: licensing/legal nuance -> Mitigation: flag models with legal-required review and exclude from auto-procurement. Risk: index overfitting to historical cohort -> Mitigation: holdout validation across regions and model families.
stakeholders: PM: Nina Patel; Data Lead: Priya Malhotra; Eng Runtime: Omar Castillo; DevRel: Maya Thompson; SRE: Lucas Bennett; Sales/Procurement liaison: Hannah Zhao; Legal reviewer: Carla Mendes.
timeline: Week 1-2: signals inventory + access; Week 3-4: labeled pilot dataset; Week 5-6: modeling and threshold experiments; Week 7: playbook draft + internal review; Week 8: canary deployment of triggers + dashboard; Week 9: validate with 2 pilot customers and ship.
